enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Remain still. Shift legs. Continue sleeping.

Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pick up phone. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of front door. Lock door with key. Put key in pocket. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Look at phone. Check time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Read patient notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Administer medication. Record data. Walk to next patient room. Repeat. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Review test results. Update patient charts. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Clear tray. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Read patient notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Record data. Walk to next patient room. Repeat. Attend meeting. Discuss patient cases. Review test results. Update patient charts. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot and pan. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add water. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk into bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for startup. Log in. Open browser. Check emails. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Scroll. Close browser. Open document. Type. Save file. Shut down laptop. Close lid. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch movie. Adjust volume. Pause. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use bathroom. Walk back. Sit down. Continue watching. Change channel. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or using phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Pick up phone. Press home button. Open app. Scroll. Type message. Send message. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still.
